# DJ Green Satyr

> Phoenix, Arizona electronic music artist and DJ. Thirty years making electronic music, rooted in leather culture, Radical Faerie and pagan tradition. Creator of the Satyr Arcana — a tarot deck you can hear, where each card is a song about a real person.

## Book
- [Book a set / EPK](https://djgreensatyr.live/booking): clubs, festivals, leather events, Radical Faerie gatherings, fundraisers, private parties and weddings. Reply within 24 hours. Email: thegreensatyr@gmail.com
- [Live sets on Mixcloud](https://www.mixcloud.com/GreenSatyr/)

## Music
- [Bandcamp](https://djgreensatyr.bandcamp.com/): Satyr Arcana I, Satyr Arcana II (Halloween 2026), singles including Dance Floor Whore
- [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/thegreensatyr)
- [Satyr Arcana card quiz](https://greensatyr.buzz/satyr-arcana/#quiz)

## Events
- [Events](https://djgreensatyr.live/events): DP, a monthly party on the last Saturday of each month with DJ Jack Daddy Dave. Halloween 2026 edition is the Satyr Arcana II release party.

## The Theatre
- [The Theatre](https://djgreensatyr.live/theatre): stage works by Britannic Zane — The Legend of Shirley Mental!, Dustin Ceed & the Skeleton Keys (psychobilly rock opera), It's a Wonderful Dyke. Weekly live DJ sets streamed on Mixcloud Live with guest DJs.

## Tools
- [Crate Detective](https://djgreensatyr.live/cratedetective): free beta tool that cleans Rekordbox libraries — duplicates, dead tracks, messy crates.
